name: Shin Sia
bio: Shin Si-ah (born 12 May 1998), is a South Korean actress. She made her debut as the lead in Park Hoon-jung's film The Witch: Part 2. The Other One. Since then, she appeared in the drama Resident Playbook as Pyo Nam-kyung, an obstetrics and gynecology resident.

credits.title: The Hole
credits.overview: Bedridden after a tragic accident, a professor is cared for by his mother-in-law, who uncovers disturbing secrets about his marriage and past, jeopardizing his recovery.

credits.title: Even If This Love Disappears Tonight
credits.overview: A high school girl wakes up each day with no memory of yesterday. When she agrees to date a shy classmate, can their love grow with every new beginning?
